workflow: golden_eval_v1 (human labels against the candidate taxonomy as a reference)

taxonomy_reference.note: Candidate taxonomy — provisional; choose the best-supported intent. You may use NEW:<snake_case> if none fits.

label_definitions.gold_intent: The primary customer-support intent of the incoming message (the customer's main request, judged from their own words).
label_definitions.gold_should_escalate: yes = route to a human; no = safe for THIS project's support AI to auto-handle. The AI can only reply on Twitter using evidence from past VirginTrains replies: it has no live train data, cannot look up bookings or accounts, cannot issue refunds or compensation, and cannot take operational action.
label_definitions.gold_resolution_type: The type of handling that would appropriately resolve the request (not necessarily what the brand actually did).
label_definitions.gold_confidence: Optional: how sure you are of this label.
label_definitions.human_notes: Free text. Required when gold_intent is NEW:<name> (explain why no candidate intent fits).

resolution_type_definitions.information_provided: answer with general information (policy, how things work, what to expect)
resolution_type_definitions.self_service: point to a link, the app, the website, a form or live-updates page
resolution_type_definitions.troubleshooting: give steps to try (e.g. reconnecting to the wifi)
resolution_type_definitions.refund: a refund needs to be discussed or processed
resolution_type_definitions.compensation: compensation or a claim (e.g. Delay Repay) needs to be discussed
resolution_type_definitions.feedback_acknowledged: thank the customer or acknowledge and pass on their feedback
resolution_type_definitions.clarification_requested: ask the customer for missing information before anything else can be done
resolution_type_definitions.escalated: a person must take over: account/booking lookup, DM, Customer Relations, formal complaint, another operator, staff action
resolution_type_definitions.unresolved: nothing reasonable can resolve it (no actionable request, or outside what the brand can do)

notes: Human columns start blank and are written only by scripts/label_golden_eval.py (audited).
No candidate intent, cluster, historical resolution label or agent output is stored in the pack or shown to the labeler.
Golden cases are never used for retrieval, prompts, thresholds or taxonomy changes; final evaluation only.
